findings.summary: Typography defaults remain Inter Display / Inter / JetBrains Mono, which is too generic for a frozen prototype baseline.
findings.recommended_fix: Require font_pair and design_direction in baseline and stop treating generic typography as a pass state.

findings.summary: Archetype renderers rely on repeated Bootstrap card/list/table shells, so outputs are structurally useful but visually bland.
findings.recommended_fix: Add aesthetic baseline pack fields for composition rules, hero pattern, surface density, and CTA tone.

findings.summary: Form input example lacks name, autocomplete, and explicit type.
findings.recommended_fix: Promote form semantics into the default shell baseline and review checks.

findings.summary: Prototype shell still misses skip link, decorative icon aria-hidden, explicit tab semantics, and scroll-margin-top anchor strategy.
findings.recommended_fix: Make Web UI baseline fields first-class in prototype review and verify-impl schemas.

findings.summary: Fallback CTA copy uses Continue / Learn More, which is too generic for a credible product-facing prototype.
findings.recommended_fix: Flag generic CTA fallbacks during review unless explicitly declared in requirement contract.

conclusion.summary: Current prototype generator is functionally usable but still too generic to be treated as a strong frozen visual baseline.
next_actions: Define aesthetic baseline pack in v1.1.8 PRD/user-story/QA
Add machine-backed draft artifacts for baseline/binding/verify/debug
Treat generic typography, generic CTA copy, and missing Web UI semantics as reviewable gaps
